newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rate on 91-day Cyprus t-bills lower at 5.42 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Cyprus t-bills lower at 5.42 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus on Wednesday sold 27 million pounds worth ($51.2 million) of 91 day treasury bills by auction at an average yield of 5.42 percent, from 5.43 percent at the previous auction held on July 9.
The bills have a July 23 issue date.
The central bank said it recieved bids totalling 32 million pounds for up to 35 million pounds worth it initially put on offer, and accepted bids for 27 million.
Yields ranged from 5.48 percent to 5.39 percent. ($=0.527 pound)
